description: Set, change or remove the booking and bill of lading numbers of a tracked shipment, or add container numbers to it. Use it when the user gives another number of a shipment already tracked (e.g. the booking of a container); track_shipment would start a new shipment instead. The tracker asks these numbers when the reference fails, and first when the carrier's booking query gives more than its container query (e.g. COSCO). `shipment` (required) is the BerthTime id, the tracked reference, or a container number on the shipment. Optional: booking_number, bl_number (an empty string removes it; omitted = unchanged), containers (ISO 6346, up to 20). At least one of them is required. Returns: shipment {id, reference, ref_type, carrier, customer_reference, status, tracking_status, phase, pol, pod, eta, original_eta, delay_hours, predicted_eta, eta_risk, vessel, containers, booking_number, bl_number, tracked_via}, retracking (true = a re-track was queued). A container number given as booking or B/L, or a malformed number, is an error. Needs write access: a read + write API key, or read + write access granted at sign-in by an owner or admin of the company.

bl_number.description: Bill of lading number to set or change; an empty string removes it. Omit to leave it as it is.

booking_number.description: Booking number to set or change; an empty string removes it. Omit to leave it as it is.

company.description: Which company to act for: its id, @handle or exact name (see list_companies). Omit for the connection's default company.

containers.description: Container numbers (ISO 6346) to add to the shipment. Numbers already on it are ignored.

shipment.description: BerthTime shipment id, or the tracked reference (container, bill of lading or booking number), or a container number on the shipment.

name: update_shipment_identifiers
title: Set booking / B/L / containers
